fields.name: fund
fields.label: Fund
fields.guidance: The fund that holds the position. Most reports filter to one fund.

fields.name: model
fields.label: Model
fields.guidance: The quant model that sized the position. Use only when the user asks about models.

fields.name: instrumentType
fields.label: Instrument Type
fields.guidance: One of Equity, Option, Future, Bond or FX. Filter on it to show one type, such as options for Greeks or bonds for duration.

fields.name: issuer
fields.label: Issuer
fields.guidance: The company that issued the instrument. Group bonds by it.

fields.name: underlying
fields.label: Underlying
fields.guidance: Set on options and futures only. Group options by it.

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.guidance: Shows only where one instrument is in view. Use market value to compare across instruments.

fields.name: mktVal
fields.label: Market Value
fields.description: Value at the close of the as-of date.
fields.guidance: The default measure of size. Use it unless the user asks for gross, net or beta-adjusted exposure.

fields.name: var95
fields.label: VaR (95%)
fields.guidance: One-day VaR. Does not add up, so the server computes it at each grouping level.

fields.name: shockedPnl
fields.label: Shocked P&L

shock.description: An equity shock as a fraction, such as -0.1 for minus 10 percent.

fields.guidance: P&L if equities move by the shock. Declare one instance per shock on the source.

positions.label: Positions
positions.description: Holdings at the close of the as-of date.
positions.guidance: One row per position. Updates live when the as-of date is today. Join to orders through the shared dimensions.

fund.description: One fund. Leave empty for all funds.

fields.name: pctNav
fields.label: % of NAV
fields.guidance: Weight of the position as a percent of its fund's NAV at the prior close. Meaningful within one fund.

fields.name: delta
fields.label: Delta
fields.guidance: Dollar delta. Set on options only, empty elsewhere.

fields.name: gamma
fields.label: Gamma
fields.guidance: Dollar gamma. Set on options only.

fields.name: vega
fields.label: Vega
fields.guidance: Dollar vega. Set on options only.

fields.name: theta
fields.label: Theta
fields.guidance: Dollar theta per day. Set on options only.

fields.name: duration
fields.label: Duration
fields.guidance: Set on bonds only.

fields.name: dv01
fields.label: DV01
fields.guidance: Set on bonds only.

fields.name: yield
fields.label: Yield
fields.guidance: Set on bonds only.

fields.name: return
fields.label: Return
fields.guidance: Return over a window. Declare one instance per window on the source, such as month to date and year to date.

fields.name: closeHistory
fields.label: Close (30d)
fields.guidance: The instrument's closing price for each of the last 30 business days through asOf, oldest first. The last point is live when asOf is today. Large across all funds: request it with a fund parameter or a filter.

fields.name: pnlHistory
fields.label: Daily P&L (30d)
fields.guidance: The position's daily P&L for each of the last 30 business days through asOf, oldest first, for a sparkline. The last point equals pnlDay, and is live when asOf is today. Large across all funds: request it with a fund parameter or a filter. To chart P&L over time, use the pnlBySector dataset, or pnlHistory by symbol.

fundSummary.label: Fund Summary
fundSummary.description: One row per fund at the close of the as-of date, with its manager, style, NAV, P&L and recent trend.
fundSummary.guidance: Use for fund-level totals and trends, such as a sparkline of each fund's P&L or drawdown. It is far smaller than positions, so prefer it for any per-fund figure.

fund.description: One fund. Leave empty for all funds.

fields.name: manager
fields.label: Manager
fields.guidance: The fund's portfolio manager. One per fund.

fields.name: style
fields.label: Style
fields.guidance: The fund's investment style: Long/Short, Macro, Credit or Multi-Strategy. One per fund, and several funds can share one. Join it onto positions by fund to group positions by style.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: NAV
fields.guidance: The fund's NAV at the prior close, as % of NAV uses.

fields.name: pnlHistory
fields.label: Daily P&L (60d)
fields.guidance: The fund's daily P&L for each of the last 60 business days through asOf, oldest first, for a sparkline. The last point equals pnlDay. To chart P&L over time, use the pnlBySector dataset, or pnlHistory by symbol.

fields.name: cumPnlHistory
fields.label: Cumulative P&L (60d)
fields.guidance: The fund's P&L accumulated over the last 60 business days, oldest first, for a sparkline. To chart it, use the pnlBySector dataset's cumPnl by day.

fields.name: drawdownHistory
fields.label: Drawdown (60d)
fields.guidance: How far the fund's cumulative P&L sits below its running peak over the last 60 business days, in USD. Always zero or less.

pnlHistory.label: P&L History
pnlHistory.description: One row per trading day, fund, strategy and symbol, with the day's P&L and the P&L accumulated since the window began.
pnlHistory.guidance: Use only for P&L over time by symbol, or to join day-by-day P&L onto positions. For charts by fund, strategy or sector, use pnlBySector, which is far smaller. Always group by day, since cumPnl adds up across holdings on a day but not across days. Set start for a request that names a period, such as the last month: the default window is 30 trading days through asOf, not a calendar month. Rows are holdings times days: about 2,000 a day for one fund, and 10,000 for all funds. A request over 75,000 rows fails, so name a fund, and filter by symbol or sector where you can.

asOf.label: As of
asOf.description: The last day of the window.

start.label: Start
start.description: The first day of the window. Leave empty for the last 30 trading days.

fund.label: Fund
fund.description: One fund. Leave empty for all funds.

fields.name: pnlDay
fields.label: Day P&L
fields.guidance: The holding's P&L on the row's day.

fields.name: cumPnl
fields.label: Cumulative P&L
fields.guidance: The holding's P&L from the window's first day through the row's day. Sums across holdings on one day. Never total it across days.

pnlBySector.label: P&L by Sector
pnlBySector.description: One row per trading day, fund, strategy and sector, with the day's P&L and the P&L accumulated since the window began.
pnlBySector.guidance: Use to chart P&L over time by fund, strategy or sector: a line, area or column chart by day, such as a fund's P&L by sector over the last month. Always group by day, since cumPnl adds up across rows on a day but not across days. Set start for a request that names a period, such as the last month: the default window is 30 trading days through asOf, not a calendar month. It sums exactly to pnlHistory, which adds the symbol: use that only for a chart by symbol.

asOf.label: As of
asOf.description: The last day of the window.

start.label: Start
start.description: The first day of the window. Leave empty for the last 30 trading days.

fund.label: Fund
fund.description: One fund. Leave empty for all funds.

fields.name: pnlDay
fields.label: Day P&L
fields.guidance: The P&L of the row's fund, strategy and sector on the row's day.

fields.name: cumPnl
fields.label: Cumulative P&L
fields.guidance: The P&L from the window's first day through the row's day. Sums across rows on one day. Never total it across days.

orders.label: Orders
orders.guidance: One row per order. Updates live when the as-of date is today. A selection in a positions grid filters orders through the shared dimensions.

fund.description: One fund. Leave empty for all funds.

fields.name: confidence
fields.label: Confidence
fields.guidance: The model's confidence in the order, from 0 to 100.

prices.label: Prices
prices.description: Daily prices for one symbol, or for every symbol.
prices.guidance: One row per symbol and trading day. Chart close against day for one symbol's price history. Join it onto positions by symbol for each symbol's latest close, or for a window's price bar. Without a symbol, rows are symbols times trading days - about 500 a day - and a request over 25,000 rows fails. Keep the date window small, such as the last few days for a latest close, and name a symbol or filter by symbol where you can.

symbol.description: One symbol. Leave empty for every symbol.

hypotheticalPortfolio.label: Hypothetical Portfolio
hypotheticalPortfolio.description: Positions and risk for a portfolio the user builds.
hypotheticalPortfolio.guidance: The position fields, priced for a portfolio of tickers and weights. Use it to stress or compare a hypothetical portfolio.

portfolio.description: A portfolio: {"holdings": [{"symbol": "AAPL", "weight": 0.5}]}, with weights as fractions. The server prices it against a notional of 100,000,000 USD.
